rules: Ask Scout about any company data through read-only connectors
Approve or reject APPROVAL-level proposals (credit lines, large payments)
Set policy rules for Scout by DM
Receives invoice questions and filing notices
Her own laptop folders (Downloads, Invoices) are searchable by the invoicing loop
Receives cost-control alerts and questions for her team's payments
Ask about the marketing budget she owns
Request files from another person's laptop
Read bank, invoicing, authorized files, the organization’s configured mail label and allowlisted Slack channels
File a found document that matches the payment (AUTO)
Payments outside policy add a NOTIFY or APPROVAL step; money is never moved (SIMULATED)
Answer messages in channels; channel history is only searched for context
